##### Project general facts

Stellar Axis is a contemporary mixed-use residential development that reflects Ajmal Estate Developers’ commitment to quality, precision, and thoughtful urban design. Conceived as a modern mid-rise landmark, the project combines residential and retail components within a cohesive architectural expression defined by clean lines, balanced proportions, and a refined aesthetic. Designed to offer both comfort and practicality, Stellar Axis presents a well-considered living environment tailored to modern lifestyles.

The development features a curated collection of lifestyle amenities that support wellness, convenience, and community interaction. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness zone, landscaped podium areas, and dedicated children’s play spaces, all complemented by reception services and round-the-clock security. The integration of retail at the ground level enhances daily ease, creating a self-sufficient setting where essential conveniences are just steps away.

The residences include studios as well as one- and two-bedroom apartments, each designed with efficient layouts, generous natural light, and contemporary interiors. Private balconies in select units extend the living space outdoors, while modern finishes and functional planning ensure a comfortable and elegant home environment. Stellar Axis represents a balanced blend of design clarity, everyday comfort, and long-term residential value.

##### Location description and benefits

International City Phase 2 in Dubai is an extension of the original International City, designed to offer a modern residential community with a focus on affordability and convenience. Located in the Al Warsan area, this phase continues the theme of diverse, globally inspired architecture, offering a variety of residential apartments within low-rise buildings. With improved infrastructure and amenities, International City Phase 2 appeals to young professionals, families, and expatriates seeking cost-effective housing with good connectivity to major areas of Dubai.

The community features a blend of residential and commercial spaces, with essential services such as supermarkets, retail outlets, and dining options within close proximity. International City Phase 2 is also known for its accessibility, with easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road, making it well-connected to other parts of the city.

One of the highlights of International City Phase 2 is its focus on creating a balanced lifestyle, offering green spaces and parks for residents to enjoy. While being a budget-friendly alternative to some of Dubai's more upscale neighborhoods, the development maintains a community-centric design, with recreational facilities and open areas that promote a healthy and active lifestyle. This makes it an ideal choice for those seeking an affordable, yet well-equipped, community in Dubai.
